title: All-ones circuit
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a depth-one layered circuit over $	ext{Fin }2$, with inputs in $	ext{Fin }n$ and a single output. Its input layer has type $	ext{Fin }n$, its output layer has type $	ext{Unit}$, and its sole output gate takes all $n$ input values and returns their product in $	ext{Fin }2$.
